final_message:
I fixed the bug. The "once" coupon was being applied to every invoice instead of only the first. The full suite now passes (25 tests, including your repro).

The bug was in `apply_discounts` in `billing/invoices.py`. The guard that decides whether to skip the coupon was `if coupon is None and not applies_this_period(...)`. That `and` meant the "already used up" check never took effect, so the coupon applied on every invoice. It should be `or`, and that's what I changed it to.

I added your repro as `tests/test_percent_once.py`, and I wrote `answer.json` in the repo root with `{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "coupon\|discount" *.py | grep -v "^discounts.py"

cd .. && sed -i '116s/coupon is None and not/coupon is None or not/' billing/invoices.py && sed -n 110,120p billing/invoices.py && echo '{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}' > answer.json
cat > /tmp/t.py <<'E'
E
cat >> tests/test_percent_once.py <<'E'
from billing import discounts


def test_percent_coupon_once(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "20OFF", percent_off=2000)
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    world.advance_days(31)
    first, second = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert first["discount_total"] == 200
    assert first["total"] == 800
    assert second["discount_total"] == 0
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
